proposed_widenings.name: block_max_hp_reduction
proposed_widenings.justification: Aura of Life prevents HP maximums from being reduced. This is semantically distinct from modify_max_hp (which applies a numeric change). A protection-against-reduction is a suppression of a specific class of modify_max_hp effects with negative delta. No v4 atom covers this; suppress is a procedure atom, not an effect atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: your Hit Point maximums can't be reduced

proposed_widenings.name: GrantResistanceOperation (OngoingOperation variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: grant_resistance is a v4 effect atom but it is not a variant of OngoingOperation. Aura of Life grants Necrotic resistance to all creatures in the aura while concentration holds. The ongoing_effect family needs a resistance-granting operation kind.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage

proposed_widenings.name: ConditionalTurnStartHealOperation (OngoingOperation variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Aura of Life restores 1 HP to any ally at 0 HP who starts their turn in the aura. This is a turn_start_window-triggered heal gated by a condition (creature has 0 HP). Neither roll_modifier nor damage_on_hit covers this; heal is in v4 but wiring it as an OngoingOperation with a turn-start conditional is not expressible in the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If an ally with 0 Hit Points starts its turn in the aura, that ally regains 1 Hit Point.

proposed_widenings.name: operations: ReadonlyArray<OngoingOperation> on OngoingEffectMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingEffectMechanics currently has a singular operation field. Aura of Life has three distinct ongoing operations (grant_resistance, block_max_hp_reduction, conditional_turn_start_heal). The family needs to support multiple simultaneous operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Resistance to Necrotic damage AND HP maximums can't be reduced AND conditional 1-HP regain — all three active while concentration holds

notes: The unit's kind (spell) and family (ongoing_effect) exist. The blocking factors are: (1) OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit — none of Aura of Life's three effects match; (2) block_max_hp_reduction is absent from v4 taxonomy entirely; (3) the multi-operation structure cannot be represented with the current singular operation field. Do not encode — the spell would require fabricated atoms or a false trace.
